items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And then the next day they called and said, “Charlie is forming a new band, would you two like to join?” We said yeah.

ctx.x: And three days later, Charlie Ventura and his manager came out to Jump Town and heard us. And then the next day they called and said, “Charlie is forming a new band, would you two like to join?” We said yeah.
You were married at this time?
